The reported undiluted percentage fell from 7.30% before the acquisition, despite an increase in shares held.
The purchase was made through Sendero’s private placement; the disclosed consideration is modest in absolute terms.
The percentage includes warrants and immediately exercisable options and declined from the prior reported level.
Each warrant has a $0.70 exercise price
Warrants add potential future shares; the release does not provide a comparison for this strike price.

This is an ownership disclosure tied to a private placement and an updated early warning report, not a change-of-control announcement. Further purchases or disposals, or a subsequent ownership filing, would establish whether the reported position changes again.
